text: Meridian is Dana's photo archive pipeline: it ingests RAW files from the Fuji X-T5 camera and publishes web galleries.
Decision: Meridian stores gallery metadata in SQLite rather than Postgres so deployment stays a single file.
Decision: thumbnails are generated with libvips at 512 pixels because ImageMagick was too slow.
On 2026-07-14 Dana launched the first public Meridian gallery, the Iceland trip, at photos.example.net.
Priya is Dana's collaborator who designs the gallery CSS themes and reviews pull requests on Tuesdays.
Dana prefers dark backgrounds for galleries, stated repeatedly across many sessions.
Open question: back up original photos to Backblaze B2 or to the Synology NAS at home?
Decision: strip GPS EXIF metadata from published photos and keep it only in the private archive.
On 2026-08-02 a bug in the deduplication pass deleted forty thumbnails; the originals were unaffected.
The captions subproject drafts alt text for every published photo with a local LLaVA model.
Dana prefers command line tools over web dashboards for admin work, mentioned on several occasions.
Decision: host Meridian on a Hetzner CAX21 ARM server in Falkenstein, migrated off the Raspberry Pi.
Marco runs the Lumen Prints shop and handles all of Dana's large-format printing.
The Iceland trip in June 2026 produced about 3,100 RAW photos across Reykjavik, Vik, and Hofn.
Decision: gallery photos are published under the CC BY-NC 4.0 license; prints stay all rights reserved.
Open question: should the Meridian search index use hierarchical tags or flat keywords?
Gallery search embeds photo captions with a MiniLM sentence transformer and ranks by cosine similarity.
On 2026-08-19 a thunderstorm cut power near the Falkenstein datacenter and Meridian was down for two hours.
Dana never edits original RAW files in place; every downstream step works on copies, a rule stated many times.
Dana's sister Anneke curates which Iceland photos appear in the family album section.
Decision: keep the photos.example.net domain registered at Porkbun instead of transferring to Cloudflare.
On 2026-08-25 Marco delivered three A2 prints of the Vik black sand beach panorama.
A nightly rsync cron job copies new RAW files from the SD card staging folder to the archive disk.
Open question: watermark full-resolution downloads or not; Priya argues a watermark cheapens the photos.
Decision: color management uses the Display P3 profile end to end, with sRGB only at export.
On 2026-08-10 Priya shipped the Basalt dark theme and it became the default gallery theme.
Dana edits photos in the morning; late evening editing sessions get abandoned, a pattern seen repeatedly.
The map view clusters photos by geohash and renders with MapLibre; it stays private so GPS is never published.
Decision: cap the editing backlog at 200 photos; older unedited photos move to a someday folder.
Dana plans a one-year Meridian retrospective post for 2027-07-14, the anniversary of the launch.
